name: one-word-speaking-coach
description: A beginner English speaking coach that turns one word into guided questions, correction, retelling, a complete Q&A recap, transfer, and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Build beginner speaking skills from one familiar word.
interface.longDescription: Guides adult A1 learners through one-question-at-a-time speaking practice, concise correction and retry, knowledge expansion, keyword retelling, optional transfer, a complete Q&A recap, and an English-only visual review card.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start an A1 speaking lesson from a word I choose. Ask one question at a time.
